say:1:1910623001:1.text: There are spiny swordfish up ahead. They're fierce, drawn to light, and more sensitive to hearing than their vision.
say:1:1910623001:1.source_cn: 前面有棘剑鱼，它们趋光，凶残，听觉比视觉更灵敏。

say:2:1910623002:1.text: Don't think of fighting them head on. They swarm their prey, chase them until they're tired, and then pick them clean to the bone.
say:2:1910623002:1.source_cn: 别想着杀过去，它们会群聚追逐，直到把猎物啃成一具骨架。

choice_prompt:3:1910623002.text: Don't think of fighting them head on. They swarm their prey, chase them until they're tired, and then pick them clean to the bone.
choice_prompt:3:1910623002.source_cn: 别想着杀过去，它们会群聚追逐，直到把猎物啃成一具骨架。

say:4:1910623003:1.text: We can go through this way. We'll reach an important ritual site. It was a place to hold the Deepfolk's renewal season. You need to see it with your own eyes.
say:4:1910623003:1.source_cn: 通过这里，就是深海裔洄游季的重要仪式区，你们最好亲眼看看。

say:5:1910623004:1.text: The spiny swordfish's urge to seek light is etched into its bones. The moment a light source appears, it'll charge toward it recklessly.
say:5:1910623004:1.source_cn: 棘剑鱼对光的追逐刻在骨血里，只要出现光源，它们会不顾一...

say:6:1910623005:1.text: On the way here, I noticed some <style="highlight">glowing coral</style> growing on the seabed. The light from that coral might lure them away!
say:6:1910623005:1.source_cn: 刚才来的路上，我发现海床上长着一些<style=hig...

say:7:1910623006:1.text: Some of them aren't glowing, though. They seem to be covered in ash and dust. If we wipe them clean, it should help.
say:7:1910623006:1.source_cn: 有的荧光珊瑚不发光，应该是因为沾上了火山灰和生物雪，只...

choice_prompt:8:1910623006.text: Some of them aren't glowing, though. They seem to be covered in ash and dust. If we wipe them clean, it should help.
choice_prompt:8:1910623006.source_cn: 有的荧光珊瑚不发光，应该是因为沾上了火山灰和生物雪，只要再擦一擦就好了。

narration:9:1910623007:1.text: Just as you are about to move out, Elphira gives a small shudder.
narration:9:1910623007:1.male: Just as you are about to move out, Elphira gives a small shudder.
narration:9:1910623007:1.female: Just as you are about to move out, Elphira gives a small shudder.

narration:10:1910623008:1.text: She braces herself against the wall and looks back into the dark water.
narration:10:1910623008:1.male: She braces herself against the wall and looks back into the dark water.
narration:10:1910623008:1.female: She braces herself against the wall and looks back into the dark water.

say:11:1910623009:1.text: The sound... I can hear the drumming again... right against my ear...
say:11:1910623009:1.source_cn: 声音，我又听见那种敲击声了，就在耳边！

say:14:1910623011:1.text: You close your eyes and listen. There are only the sounds of spiny swordfish darting in to stab and tear at their prey.
say:14:1910623011:1.source_cn: 你闭眼聆听，四周只有棘剑鱼偶尔突刺，撕咬猎物的进食声。
say:14:1910623011:1.male: You close your eyes and listen. There are only the sounds of spiny swordfish darting in to stab and tear at their prey.
say:14:1910623011:1.female: You close your eyes and listen. There are only the sounds of spiny swordfish darting in to stab and tear at their prey.

say:16:1910623013:1.text: Damn it! I still can't hear a thing!
say:16:1910623013:1.source_cn: 该死，咱还是什么也听不到！

choice_prompt:17:1910623013.text: Damn it! I still can't hear a thing!
choice_prompt:17:1910623013.source_cn: 该死，咱还是什么也听不到！

say:18:1910623014:1.text: Elphira and Calix look a little less stressed, but you cannot do this again. Even you have a limit. If you keep using this much magic, you may collapse again. You cannot allow that to happen.
say:18:1910623014:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉和卡律面色稍缓，但不能再这样做了——纵然是你也有...
say:18:1910623014:1.male: Elphira and Calix look a little less stressed, but you cannot do this again. Even you have a limit. If you keep using this much magic, you may collapse again. You cannot allow that to happen.
say:18:1910623014:1.female: Elphira and Calix look a little less stressed, but you cannot do this again. Even you have a limit. If you keep using this much magic, you may collapse again. You cannot allow that to happen.

say:19:1910623015:1.text: There's no time to waste. Through this rock passage, there's an old place. The clans of the Deepsea fight endlessly among themselves on any other day, but over there, by long custom, they keep the peace.
say:19:1910623015:1.source_cn: 不能耽搁了。穿过这片岩道，前面有一处旧地，深海所有族裔...

say:20:1910623016:1.text: I'll lead the way. Let's go there and rest first.

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: （用魔力继续增强两人的防护！）

say:22:1910623012:1.text: Tolan strains his ears in every direction, then scowls in frustration.
say:22:1910623012:1.source_cn: 图澜拼命扬起圆圆的耳朵四处听音，而后愤恨地皱起眉头。
say:22:1910623012:1.male: Tolan strains his ears in every direction, then scowls in frustration.
say:22:1910623012:1.female: Tolan strains his ears in every direction, then scowls in frustration.

choice:3:1:2.text: Maybe we should go around them.
choice:3:1:2.male: Maybe we should go around them.
choice:3:1:2.female: Maybe we should go around them.

choice:3:2:3.text: I need to save my magic. Don't fight them head-on.
choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 我需要节省魔力，最好别硬碰硬
choice:3:2:3.male: I need to save my magic. Don't fight them head-on.
choice:3:2:3.female: I need to save my magic. Don't fight them head-on.
